primaryPanel.heading: Describe your business problem
primaryPanel.description: Type your message in the field below. The Planning Agent will ask clarifying questions and build a structured business model as you describe your situation.

chatInterface.description: Conversational interface between user and the Planning Agent. Displays conversation history with per-message role indicators (user / assistant). Supports streaming agent responses with a typing indicator.
chatInterface.messageInputPlaceholder: Describe your business problem or answer the agent's question...

integrationStatus.pendingNoticeHeading: Planning Agent is in test mode
integrationStatus.pendingNoticeBody: The AI Planning Agent is temporarily unavailable while the Anthropic Claude API integration is being finalized. The Send Message button is disabled. You can still review prior conversation history if resuming a session.

llmUnavailable.heading: Planning Agent temporarily unavailable
llmUnavailable.body: The AI Planning Agent could not process your message at this time. Your message has been preserved. Please try again in a few minutes.

rateLimitExceeded.heading: Request limit reached
rateLimitExceeded.body: You have reached the maximum number of Planning Agent requests for this hour. The limit resets in {retryAfter} seconds. Please wait before sending additional messages.

rateLimitWarning.heading: Approaching request limit
rateLimitWarning.body: You have used 80% of your Planning Agent request allocation for this hour. Consider summarizing your next message to make the most of your remaining requests.

sessionNotFound.heading: Session not found
sessionNotFound.body: This planning session could not be found or is no longer accessible. You will be returned to your session list.

businessModelStatusCard.heading: Business Model
businessModelStatusCard.description: The Planning Agent builds your business model from your conversation. It shows the actors, goals, activities, and constraints identified so far.

incompleteModelWarning.heading: Business model incomplete
incompleteModelWarning.body: The business model does not yet have enough information to generate a hypothesis. Continue describing your business problem to help the agent understand your situation.

lowConfidenceNotice.body: Confidence is below the threshold needed for hypothesis generation (69%). Continue the conversation to provide more context.

hypothesisReady.body: A solution hypothesis has been generated. Review the hypothesis to see recommended ADSP services.

specialistConsultationPanel.heading: Specialist Consultation
specialistConsultationPanel.description: Once a solution hypothesis is accepted, you can consult specialist agents for deep technical guidance on each recommended ADSP service.

specialists.label: Form Service Specialist
specialists.stubNotice: Form Service Specialist is not yet available. Specialist integrations are pending OPEN-005 resolution.

specialists.label: PDF Service Specialist
specialists.stubNotice: PDF Service Specialist is not yet available.

specialists.label: Comment Service Specialist
specialists.stubNotice: Comment Service Specialist is not yet available.

specialists.label: Notification Service Specialist
specialists.stubNotice: Notification Service Specialist is not yet available.

specialistUnavailableError.heading: Specialist temporarily unavailable
specialistUnavailableError.body: The specialist agent for this service could not be reached. You have been returned to the planning session. Please try again later.

disabledSpecialistNotice.heading: Specialist not enabled
disabledSpecialistNotice.body: This specialist agent is not enabled for your tenant. Contact your ADSP tenant administrator to enable specialist consultations.

stepNavigation.cancelWarning: Your session progress is automatically saved. You can resume this session at any time from your session list.

contextSummary.heading: Welcome back
contextSummary.description: You are resuming a previous planning session. Here is a summary of where you left off:

staleSummary.heading: Extended context recap
staleSummary.body: This session has been idle for more than 7 days. The Planning Agent will provide a detailed recap of all prior decisions and open questions when messaging is enabled.

onLoad.description: Load the planning session state including title, status, businessModelId, lastResumedAt, and timestamps. Used to populate the context summary banner on re-entry.
Load conversation history (last 50 messages paginated) for display in the chat interface.
Load the current business model to display confidence score and concept count in the side panel status card.

onSubmit.description: Submit a user message to the Planning Agent. INT-001 is STUB/fail-closed — returns 503 until activated. Message content is Protected B.
Delegate to a specialist agent for deep service guidance. All specialist integrations are STUB/fail-closed (INT-003..006) pending OPEN-005.
onSubmit.triggeredBy: Consult specialist button in side panel

onSubmit.description: Update session status to paused when user clicks Save and Exit.

dataBindings.emptyState: Your conversation will appear here as you describe your business problem and the Planning Agent responds.

securityNotes.fieldMasking: conversationMessage.content is redacted in server-side structured logs per Winston log redaction config. userId and tenantId are not rendered in the client UI. Message content is never appended to URL query strings.
securityNotes.storageRestriction: No Protected B fields (message content, model data, hypothesis) may be written to localStorage, sessionStorage, or document.cookie. In-memory React state only.
securityNotes.rateLimiting: Express-rate-limit on /messages and /specialists endpoints. UI displays warning at 80% utilization (TC-069) and enforces stop at 50 requests/hour per tenant (TC-024, BR-003).
